modelReview.summary: The manuscript fails to report the actual ANCOVA results, lacks a defined study question, contains contradictory statements, and overinterprets an unbound exploratory analysis. These issues prevent any meaningful review.

findings.title: Results section contains no statistical output
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript does not answer the study question; critical model estimates, p-values, and effect sizes are absent, rendering it useless for interpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Report all ANCOVA terms: group effect (F(2,235)=2.19, p=0.114), covariate effects, model fit, and ideally adjusted means and contrasts.

findings.title: Prespecified study question is never stated
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot assess whether the analysis addresses a meaningful hypothesis or aligns with the objective.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state the study question in the Introduction, and explain how the ANCOVA model was chosen to answer it.

findings.title: Analysis is unbound and exploratory, but claims imply confirmatory strength
findings.whyItMatters: Unbound analyses have inflated false-positive risk; the manuscript's 'interpretable local evidence' statement is overconfident.
findings.actionableFix: Bind the analysis to a pre-registered specification or downgrade all claims to explicitly exploratory language, acknowledging inflated Type I error.

findings.title: Contradictory statements about missing artifacts and estimates
findings.whyItMatters: The manuscript says 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact' and 'No estimate-like records', yet both exist; this undermines trust in the report's accuracy.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or correct these limitations statements after verifying that the manuscript reflects the actual artifacts.

findings.title: No participant flow or baseline characteristics reported
findings.whyItMatters: Complete-case analysis may be biased; without details on initial cohort, exclusions, and group demographics, selection bias and generalizability cannot be assessed.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a STROBE flow diagram and a table of baseline characteristics by group, comparing complete-case to excluded records.

findings.title: Statistical method is described vaguely
findings.whyItMatters: Reproducibility requires a clear statement of the model; readers should not need to infer from artifacts.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state: ANCOVA with outcome_cont as dependent variable, group as a three-level factor, and age and severity as covariates, using type III SS.

findings.title: No effect sizes or clinical significance reported
findings.whyItMatters: P-values alone do not convey magnitude of effects; readers cannot judge practical importance.
findings.actionableFix: Compute and report partial eta-squared for each effect (sum_sq_effect / (sum_sq_effect + sum_sq_residual)).

findings.title: No literature context or references provided
findings.whyItMatters: The study lacks scientific framing; readers cannot gauge importance or compare with prior work.
findings.actionableFix: Add a brief background with references or explicitly state this is an internal-only analysis.

missingEvidence: Variable dictionary or description of outcome_cont, group levels, age, severity
Pre-specified study protocol or analysis specification
Participant flow diagram and baseline demographics table
Adjusted group means and contrasts with confidence intervals
